item.title: How to Estimate the Resource Consumption of Monitoring Components in a Kubernetes Cluster
item.description: The monitoring metrics described in this article cover only the basic Kubernetes metrics, not business-related metrics. The components involved are prometheus-server, kube-state-metrics, and node-exporter, and the data retention period is 3 days. 1.
